title: dcmunpack
description: Sorts and converts a directory of DICOM files (Siemens, GE, Philips) into an output hierarchy with nifti (nii), mgh, mgz, or analyze output formats.

src.description: Dicom source directory. You can specify more than one.
src.title: Source Directory

targ.description: Output directory. Do not need to include when just getting information about what is in the directory.
targ.title: Target Directory

run.description: Specify unpacking rules for a given run (series). Eg, "-run 3 bold nii f.nii".
run.title: Run Specification

auto_runseq.description: Save all scans in the targetdir as runo.seqname.format.
auto_runseq.title: Auto Run Sequence

keep_scouts.description: Unpack series with 'scout' or 'setter' in the name.
keep_scouts.title: Keep Scouts Flag

scanonly.description: Only scan the directory and put result in file.
scanonly.title: Scan Only

one_per_dir.description: Assume that there is only one dicom series in each subdir.
one_per_dir.title: One Per Directory Flag

pre.description: Input prefix (i.e., input file name init string).
pre.title: File Prefix

pat.description: Input pattern (i.e., string that occurs in the middle of file name).
pat.title: File Pattern

no_infodump.description: Do not create the fname-infodump.dat file.
no_infodump.title: No Infodump Flag

copy_only.description: Only copy dicom files to output directory (implies -no-convert).
copy_only.title: Copy Only Flag

no_convert.description: Do not convert to output format.
no_convert.title: No Convert Flag

force_update.description: Convert even if output is newer than the input dicom.
force_update.title: Force Update Flag

max.description: Print out max in given dicom file.
max.title: Max Flag

key_string.description: Put keystring before each run line (good for searching).
key_string.title: Key String

index_out.description: Save index of files to index.out.dat (for re-use).
index_out.title: Index Out

index_in.description: Read index of files (can make things much faster on 2nd run).
index_in.title: Index In

it_dicom.description: Add -it dicom to mri_convert cmd line.
it_dicom.title: IT DICOM Flag

no_exit_on_error.description: Continue to unpack data even if there is an error in conversion.
no_exit_on_error.title: No Exit on Error Flag

run_skip.description: Skip a given run (good when using -auto-runseq).
run_skip.title: Run Skip

no_rescale_dicom.description: Turn off DICOM rescaling based on tags (0028,1052) (0028,1053).
no_rescale_dicom.title: No Rescale DICOM Flag

no_dwi.description: Turn off trying to read DWI parameters.
no_dwi.title: No DWI Flag

extra_info.description: Add session info to each line of the info file (pat, date, man, scan, field, serno).
extra_info.title: Extra Info Flag

first_dicom.description: Copy first dicom file into output folder.
first_dicom.title: First DICOM Flag

phase.description: Add the string _phase to volumes that are phase images based on ImageType.
phase.title: Phase Flag

fips.description: Fips parameters: project, site, birnid, visit.
fips.title: Fips Fields

xml_only.description: For fips, only create xml file, do not convert to output.
xml_only.title: XML Only Flag
